about: How a kept HTML page stands when it is opened (docs/archive.md, "An HTML page"): the sandbox it runs in, which the server's policy carries and the console plugin bundle's frame gives the page it stands, and the rest of the policy the server sends it under. The scripts under bridges/ are the lines the server writes ahead of the page's own: link.js and clipboard.js each stand as one script, picture.js is a function the server calls with this design's viewer, scheme.js one it calls with the scheme a page's questions about the scheme are answered with, and sound.js is a function the server calls with the page's sounds, where the page writes an audio element, after the player's script.
